text_block_list.text: When returning from an outing with Mejiro Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The sun's already gone down completely, huh.
Feels like we just stepped out a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "That just shows what a fulfilling time you had!"
choice_data_list: Looks like you were able to take a nice breather.
Looks like you got to relax and unwind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, so much that I completely lost track of time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for everything as always,
Trainer!"
choice_data_list: When you need it, let's take another breather!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'd love to, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! It's not really a problem, per se...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer!
C-Could we take a breather for just a little bit longer!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Even though it's right by the academy, the view from here is truly something special!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I'm sorry.
For making unreasonable requests and dragging you along."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I feel like I'm still
really letting my hair down!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, rather than worrying, I just wanted to do everything I possibly could.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To run toward our big goal from here on,
we need to make sure we catch our breath properly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, I've really come to appreciate
how important going out with you is, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even when you overthink things about the race, taking a breather
can help sort out your feelings...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, being with you, Trainer,
makes me feel your trust and fills me with confidence!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"My Trainer supports me, which is why
I can run with all my might without any worries..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So going out with you, Trainer,
has become something I truly can't do without!
choice_data_list: Wanna stay together a little longer today?
Alright, let's go out a lot more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So going out with you, Trainer,
has become something I truly can't do without!
choice_data_list: Shall we stay together a little longer today?
Alright, let's go out together a lot more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's stay here together just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's the first star! Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Next time, climbing a mountain to look at the stars
might be really nice too!
And so, the break with Mejiro Ryan continued until it grew dark all around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: For you too, Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Because it lets me learn more about you
Because I get to learn more about you

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... That's kind of embarrassing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have strong points I can take pride in,
but I have my weaknesses too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Please get to know all of that about me.
I think that'll help us truly trust each other.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, please!
And so, the bond of trust with Mejiro Ryan grew closer through taking a breather.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~, are you sure!?
To tell you the truth, there are so many places I want to visit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Kayaking down rivers, long-distance swimming in the ocean,
and mountain climbing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I need to train my body even more!
Make sure you get ready too, Trainer!"
And so, along with my bond of trust with Mejiro Ryan, the time we spent muscle training grew as well.
